exercise.en: It's time to exercise, let's go to the playground.
exercise.cn: 该锻炼了，我们去操场吧。

time.en: I don't have much time to play after school.
time.cn: 放学后我没有多少时间玩。

run.en: He can run faster than any boy in our class.
run.cn: 他比我们班任何男孩都跑得快。

jump.en: The little frog jumps into the green pond.
jump.cn: 小青蛙跳进了绿色的池塘。

swim.en: We swim in the pool in summer.
swim.cn: 夏天我们在游泳池游泳。

swim.en: Fish swim happily in the clear river.
swim.cn: 鱼儿在清澈的小河里欢快地游。

play.en: The children play games together in the playground.
play.cn: 孩子们一起在操场上玩游戏。

sport.cn: 足球是我最喜欢的运动。

sport.en: Sport is good for our body and mind.
sport.cn: 运动对我们的身体和精神都好。

healthy.en: Sport and good food make us healthy and happy.
healthy.cn: 运动和好的食物让我们健康又快乐。
